title: Tape change and a note about living with Mercer's mother in Washington
summary: Billie reminds him that he roomed with Mercer's mother in Washington during Navy school; tape is changed.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Billie's reminding me … put this on tape too because a lot of people don't know that I lived with, had a room with Mercer's mother when I was in Washington, D.C. at the school of music. The Navy School of Music.
Oh, okay, I'll come back to that. When I got up I actually bumped this. Does it look fine? Male voice- You're fine, both of you sound great.
